name: Passover (Pesach)
description: Commemoration of Yahuah's deliverance from Egypt and Messiah's sacrifice.

name: Feast of Unleavened Bread - Start
description: First day of the 7-day Feast of Unleavened Bread — no leaven eaten.

name: Feast of Unleavened Bread - End
description: Last day of Unleavened Bread — a closing Shabbaton.

name: Feast of Weeks (Shavuot)
description: Commemorates the giving of the Torah at Sinai and the Spirit in Acts 2.

name: Feast of Trumpets (Yom Teruah)
description: Day of shofar blasts marking the beginning of the 7th month.

name: Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur)
description: A solemn day of fasting, repentance, and intercession.

name: Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot)
description: Seven days of dwelling in temporary shelters and rejoicing.

name: Last Great Day (Shemini Atzeret)
description: Sacred assembly on the 8th day — the conclusion of Sukkot.
